## What happened
NVIDIA closed the week up 4.2%, outpacing the S&P 500's 0.8% gain. Trading volume ran roughly 30% above the 30-day average.

## Why the price moved
The company announced three new hyperscaler partnerships at GTC 2026 and several sell-side analysts raised their price outlooks following the event [1]. The broader semiconductor sector also rallied on stronger-than-expected TSMC wafer shipments [2].

## What it means for a first-year investor
This move reflects continued demand for AI data center GPUs — a sector-wide tailwind rather than a company-specific surprise. One way to think about this: NVDA is moving with its sub-industry, not breaking out alone.
